title: curvo perception validation on image data
capability_under_test: perception: pixels -> membrane geometry (mean curvature H, neck radius)
scope_note: Benchmark images are synthetic BY NECESSITY: exact geometry ground truth is required to measure recovery accuracy, and only rendered images carry it. The real-image probe characterizes the fluorescence-vs-density modality gap honestly.

operating_envelope.definition: cap depth in [1.3, 2.2] x PSF sigma (data-driven reliable band)
operating_envelope.coverage68_note: per-frame bootstrap CI UNDER-COVERS (median cov68 ~ 0.33 vs 0.68 nominal): the point estimate is trustworthy, the per-frame uncertainty needs widening. Flagged, not hidden.
operating_envelope.core_definition: 13 resolution-matched conditions: PSF sigma = 18 nm, pixel size 2-4 nm/px, photons 40-400, cap depth c_eff 0.045-0.08, off-center <= 6 px. NOTE: PSF sigma=10 nm and pixel size=1 nm/px each pass a naive fine-resolution reading but sit far outside the core band (76%, 98%) and are excluded by measurement.

robustness_finding: partial occlusion tolerated (uses contiguous central dip); shot-noise x2 absorbed; background gradient and neighboring structure ~2x error (intensity-baseline confounders that shift the cap-fit reference)

end_to_end_image_to_force.closes_gap: STED test used REPORTED radii; this uses geometry EXTRACTED from pixels
end_to_end_image_to_force.finding: identified forces (25, 40 pN) recovered at 6% bias from pixels; 55/70 pN correctly REFUSED as UNDETERMINED by the anti-force-astrology guardrail rather than reporting a biased point value

modality_gap: geometry: top-down ring not side-view cap
sample: subtomogram average not single fluorescence frame
real_image_probe.verdict: NATIVE front end does NOT transfer (modality mismatch, as expected). The underlying curvature-measurement PRIMITIVE DOES transfer: a contrast-flipped radial fit recovers a physically sensible membrane radius. Closing the gap requires a modality adapter (contrast flip + ring/cap geometry), the documented seam for a real super-res dataset.

overall_verdict: Perception is quantitatively validated on a held-out image benchmark with exact ground truth: H recovered to ~10-18% across a defined operating envelope, graceful degradation characterized, and forces recovered end-to-end from pixels at 6% bias with the identifiability guardrail intact. The per-frame CI under-covers (documented). The fluorescence front end does not transfer to cryo-ET density images (expected modality gap); the underlying curvature primitive does. A modality adapter is the documented seam.
